primary.title: How to avoid TDS deduction on EPF withdrawal: Eligibility and rules explained
primary.summary: Withdrawing from your EPF before five years may incur TDS if the amount is over ₹50,000. Exemptions exist for those with nil tax liability who can submit Form 121. Details here.
